text:
maria: quick question — we need to settle rerank /v1/rerank output contract before the console change. current prod returns a single float per candidate (0-1). some infra teams want raw logits for post-processing, others want stable normalized scores for dashboards :thinking_face:
aj: i'd push for a single canonical score field and an optional metadata map. adding multiple score types in the core response will explode telemetry and billing math
simon: +1 to canonical score. we can let model adapters produce a `score_meta` blob with `logit`/`confidence` but console only displays the normalized score by default
maria: ok, what about range and monotonicity? teams expect comparable scores across model versions for alerts
elaine: we should document that `score` is monotonic but not calibrated across different model families. for cross-model comparisons use `score_meta.calibration_tag` and our eval-run IDs
aj: proposes schema:
```
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","score":0.82,"meta":{"logit":2.3,"cal_tag":"v2-cal-2026-02"}},
    {"id":"c2","score":0.41}
  ],
  "model":"rerank-v2",
  "score_type":"prob"
}
```
simon: that looks fine. console should treat `score` as the display unit and have a toggle to show `logit` when you opt into extended telemetry
maria: another concern: model affinity / fanout. rerank callers sometimes want to fanout to many specialized rerankers. that's N * candidate cost — how do we express quotas and routing?
elaine: we could add `model_affinity` hints in the request that say preferred model(s) and fallback list. routing picks cheapest compatible model respecting affinity and quota
aj: +1. also need a per-request `max_fanout` so callers can't silently blow up cost. default to 1 unless you have Dedicated or explicit quota. put it in header: `X-Rerank-Max-Fanout: 3`
maria: console UX: show per-route fanout usage and per-model cost breakdown. needs to be in current console plan (screenshot mock later) :eyes:
simon: telemetry: sample raw logits at low rate (0.1%) by default, full sample for teams with eval retention addon. avoid sending candidate text in telemetry by default (PII)
infra-bot: note: routing change deployed to staging. canary 20% for requests with `X-Rerank-Max-Fanout` > 1 — monitor cost burn metric `rerank.fanout_cost` for 72h
elaine: fallback policy — if preferred model is out of capacity, auto-fallback to compatible cheaper variant and annotate response with `fallback_from` and `fallback_reason`
maria: sounds good. last thing: billing units. do we bill per-candidate-per-model-call or unitize into `score_units`? we need a stable mapping for accounting
aj: propose `score_unit = candidate_tokens * model_compute_coeff`. console can roll up `score_units` per route and per-model. keep it opaque to callers but surface in usage APIs
simon: agree. action items:
- spec schema + examples (aj)
- console mock for fanout + cost (maria)
- telemetry sampling plan + privacy checklist (elaine)
- rollout canary + alert thresholds (infra)

maria: i'll open the PR with the schema and link it here. thanks all :thumbsup:
